acceptance.name: Highest point ≤ 315 m (lidar ~310 m near mile 0.9)
Lowest point ≥ 244 m (road ~247 m at Peachtree Creek; catches the bridge reading the creek at 236.5 m)
Peachtree Creek bridge is never a dip
Cardiac Hill rises 30–42 m (Peachtree Creek to Piedmont Hospital; lidar +37 m)
Cardiac Hill survives as a climb of ≥ +3.5%
Peachtree St rise into Midtown 17–29 m (mile 4.1 to 5.2; lidar +23 m)
10th St falls 13–25 m to the finish (lidar ~18 m)

checkpoints.name: Finish: 10th St at Charles Allen Dr

description: Lenox Square to Midtown down Peachtree Road: a mostly downhill first half to Peachtree Creek, then Cardiac Hill, about 37 m in 0.7 miles to Piedmont Hospital, small rolls into Midtown, and a slight descent along 10th Street to the finish by Piedmont Park. The world's largest 10K, run every Fourth of July. Unofficial.

source.notes: 2026 course (unchanged since 1978 apart from 2008): Peachtree Rd south from Lenox Square, left on 10th St, finish at Charles Allen Dr, as described in the organiser's 2026 participant guide and finish-area map. Route traced over OpenStreetMap streets; the start is placed so the course measures 10 km along them, which puts it in front of the mall's main entrance. No certificate splits are published, so distance is calibrated to the start and finish only. Elevations from USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar (Georgia statewide, 2018); the Peachtree Creek bridge is interpolated. Unofficial.
